faq.question: What does Indira mean?
faq.answer: Indira is associated with the Sanskrit form إِنْدِيرَا, whose core sense is indira; beauty, splendour (sanskrit).

faq.question: What is the origin of Indira?
faq.answer: Indira is associated with Sanskrit. Indira is Sanskrit इन्दिरा (indirā), meaning 'beauty, splendour'. It is used as a female given name in South and Central Asia.

faq.question: Is Indira an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Indira an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Indira can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
